items.stem: Write 1/12 as a decimal.
Without dividing, explain why 1/25 is a terminating decimal but 1/275 is a recurring decimal.
items.answer: 25 has only 2 and 5 as prime factors, so it divides a power of 10. 275 = 25 × 11 has the prime factor 11, which does not divide any power of 10, so the decimal recurs.
items.markingKey: B1 prime factors 2 and 5 only terminate; B1 other prime factor gives recurring. [2]
